cohort: The study included 75 fetuses with antenatally diagnosed omphalocele and 21 with gastroschisis, all followed-up and delivered at a single university hospital.
finding: Fetuses with omphalocele had significantly more associated structural and chromosomal anomalies compared to those with gastroschisis, with prognosis for omphalocele dependent on these anomalies and bowel compromise being the main determining factor for gastroschisis.
birth_weight: Measured, but specific values not reported; did not differ between groups.
gest_age: Measured, but specific values not reported; did not differ between groups.
